result.description:
IKAD Engineering is a proud Western Australian private company with a national and international footprint. We provide a broad range of Project Management and Engineering solutions across a wide variety of Industry Sectors including Defence, Industrial, Mining, Marine, Oil & Gas, and Water Technology.

We are currently seeking applications for suitably qualified and experienced Boilermaker/ Welders with extensive Workshop/ Marine fabrication experience to join our great local team.

The Role

You will possess a commitment to work as a team player, be adaptable to a changing environment, have the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and be prepared to work overtime and in remote locations when required to carry out the following duties;

    Reading and interpreting drawings or taking verbal instructions to mark out, cut, weld and assemble steel;
    Perform welding in accordance with approved weld procedures and codes;
    Interpret welding symbols to ensure correct welding techniques;
    Carry out basic maintenance of welding machine and equipment to keep a clean and safe work area; and
    Follow all workshop and site safety requirements.

The successful candidates must have previous workshop experience and be able to demonstrate the following essential personal attributes and skills:

    Sound knowledge all aspects of fabrication, including structural, plate work & piping with carbon steel & exotic materials
    FCAW/GTAW/MMAW welding experience
    Trade Qualified 
    5+ years’ trade experience
    Physically fit & enthusiastic
    Ensuring all activities are completed in a safe and efficient manner
    Identify and report potential safety hazards and take appropriate actions
    Confinded Space Entry and Working Safely at Heights

Desirable Tickets (not essential) 

    Elevated Work Platform
    Recognised training certification in rigging, dogging & forklift
    Light Ridged Drivers licence 

Benefits

    State of the art newly built workshop
    Exciting and specialised projects
    Secure, permanent full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000-$90000. 
    Ongoing Training and Development 
    Based in Henderson, Perth WA  
    Well known international, family & locally owned engineering company
    An all-inclusive workplace, supportive and welcoming of diverse backgrounds

 

If you are interested then please Apply now!
